_comment: Attribute prose for the REST reference pages, keyed by OpenAPI definition. The published spec describes almost none of its properties, so this file covers every attribute the endpoint pages reach. Add an entry here when the spec gains a definition; a property with neither spec text nor an entry renders with its name and type alone. The _operations map is separate: keyed by "METHOD /path", it replaces the opening paragraph of a page where the spec's own description is too thin to tell a reader whether the endpoint applies to them.

_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/cloud-providers/pu: Lists the cloud providers TigerGraph operates. Use an id from this list as the cloud_provider_id when you create a workgroup.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/cloud-providers: Lists the Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) providers registered to your organization, the cloud accounts you own that Savanna deploys into. Use an id from this list as the cloud_provider_id when you create a workgroup.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/cloud-providers/{c: Returns a single Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) provider, including its status, the AWS resources Savanna created in your account, and its component versions.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/cloud-providers: Registers a cloud account you own with Savanna so workgroups can be deployed into it. This is the Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) setup step, and it grants Savanna a cross-account IAM role in your AWS account.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/cloud-providers/v: Checks whether a Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) registration would succeed, without creating anything.
_operations.PUT /controller/v4/v2/cloud-providers/{c: Renames a Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) provider or records a version against it. Use the upgrade endpoint to change what is deployed in the cloud account.
Upgrades the Savanna components deployed in a Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) provider's cloud account, and optionally resizes its node groups.
_operations.DELETE /controller/v4/v2/cloud-providers: Unregisters a Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) provider and removes the Savanna components from that cloud account. Delete its workgroups first.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workg: Adds an IP address or CIDR range to a workgroup allow list.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workgr: Returns your current public IP address and whether the workgroup allow list permits it.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/workgroups: Creates a workgroup with the selected cloud provider, region, and deployment settings.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workg: Creates a workspace in a workgroup. The workspace's database is created with it.
Creates an in-database GSQL user for a workspace.
_operations.DELETE /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{wor: Deletes a database from a workgroup.
Deletes a workspace from a workgroup.
Removes an IP address or CIDR range from a workgroup allow list.
Deletes an in-database GSQL user from a workspace.
_operations.PUT /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workgr: Disables IP allow-list enforcement for a workgroup.
Enables IP allow-list enforcement for a workgroup.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workgr: Returns the status of a backup restore job.
Returns the backup schedule for a workspace.
Returns details for a database in a workgroup.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/workspaces/meta: Lists the regions, TigerGraph versions, and workspace types available to your organization.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workgr: Returns details for a workgroup in your organization.
Returns details for a workspace in a workgroup.
Lists the IP addresses and CIDR ranges permitted by a workgroup allow list.
Lists the backups for a workspace.
Lists the in-database GSQL users for a workspace.
_operations.GET /users: Lists the users in your organization. This endpoint does not support API key authentication.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/workgroups: Lists the workgroups in your organization.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workgr: Lists the schedules for a workspace.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workg: Restores a workspace from a backup.
Creates or replaces the backup schedule for a workspace.
_operations.PUT /controller/v4/v2/workgroups/{workgr: Renames a database in a workgroup.
Updates a workgroup name, application logging, or encryption settings.
Updates an entry in a workgroup allow list.
Updates an in-database GSQL user's password.
_operations.PUT /users/{userId}/roles: Updates an organization user's role. This endpoint does not support API key authentication.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/addons/meta: Lists the add-ons available to your organization. Use an id from this list as addons_id when you install an add-on or enable one on a workspace.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/addons/{addonsID}: Installs an add-on for your organization, or enables or disables it.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/installed-addons: Lists the add-ons installed for your organization.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/addons/{addonsID}/: Lists the workspaces that have a given add-on enabled.
_operations.GET /controller/v4/v2/installed-addons/{: Lists configurations of a given name for an installed add-on.
_operations.POST /controller/v4/v2/add-ons/{installe: Creates a configuration for an installed add-on.
_operations.PUT /controller/v4/v2/add-ons/{installed: Updates a configuration of an installed add-on.
_operations.DELETE /controller/v4/v2/add-ons/{instal: Deletes a configuration of an installed add-on.
